skill.name: softsync-workflows
skill.description: Run the workspace automations — manual workflows and published ones — and check their results. Use when the user wants to start one of their automations or asks whether one finished.
skill.summary: Run, monitor, and review SoftSync workspace workflows.
skill.author: softsync-lab

content.value_statement: Manual workflow operations can require several tool calls and status checks. This skill guides reliable workflow launches, monitoring, and result review.
actual_capabilities: List manual workflows that are ready to run.
Identify required workflow inputs before starting a run.
Start manual workflows with their declared name and input.
List published workflow endpoints and run selected workflows.
Monitor long-running workflow status by run identifier.
Review recent runs and cancel active or waiting runs.
limitations: It cannot create or edit workflow definitions.
It depends on the available SoftSync workflow tools and workspace access.
It cannot resume a run after cancellation.
It does not replace confirmation for workflows that change records or send messages.

use_cases.title: Run Team Automations
use_cases.description: Start a manual workflow, provide missing inputs, and monitor completion from one guided request.

use_cases.title: Check Published Workflows
use_cases.description: Find published workflow endpoints, launch a selected workflow, and review its returned result or run status.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Activity
use_cases.description: Inspect recent workflow runs, understand their outcomes, and cancel active runs when necessary.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Workflows
prompt_templates.prompt: List the workflows I can run manually and show the input each workflow requires.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the [workflow name] workflow with this input: [input]. Ask me for any required missing fields before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor a Long Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the published workflow [slug]. If it returns a run identifier, monitor it until completion and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Stop Runs
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the newest workflow runs, summarize their statuses, and cancel only the active runs I identify after I confirm.

output_examples.input: List the manual workflows I can run.
output_examples.output: Available workflows are listed with their descriptions and required inputs. No workflow is started.

output_examples.input: Start the weekly report workflow with the sales team as the target.
output_examples.output: The workflow requires the target value and is ready to start after confirmation. The skill will then monitor the run and report its result.

output: Recent runs are shown newest first.
Each entry includes its outcome and whether it is still active.
Active runs can be cancelled after confirmation.

best_practices: Confirm the workflow name and inputs before starting any run.
Explain record changes or messages before requesting confirmation.
Use run status checks for long workflows and summarize the final output.
anti_patterns: Do not start a workflow when required input is missing.
Do not pass undeclared input to a workflow.
Do not cancel active runs without identifying the intended runs and receiving confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill run?
faq.answer: It runs manual workflows and published workflows available in the connected SoftSync workspace.

faq.question: What happens when input is missing?
faq.answer: The skill identifies the missing input and asks you for it before starting the workflow.

faq.question: Can it monitor long workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks the run status until the workflow finishes, then reports the output.

faq.question: Can it review previous runs?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists workspace runs with their outcomes, newest first.

faq.question: Can it cancel a workflow run?
faq.answer: Yes. It can cancel runs that are still active or waiting after you confirm the intended runs.

faq.question: Does it change records or send messages automatically?
faq.answer: A workflow may do so. The skill requires explaining those effects and confirming before the run.
